text.tagline: Klang aus Relais, Glocken und Fernschreibern.
text.tagline_en: Sound from relays, bells and teleprinters.
text.blurb: {count} programs built from the machines of the telephone exchange and the office: relays, ringers, teleprinters, motors. Measured, tuned and documented in Bielefeld.
text.blurb_de: {count} Klangprogramme aus den Maschinen der Vermittlungsstelle und des Bueros: Relais, Wecker, Fernschreiber, Motoren. Gemessen, gestimmt und dokumentiert in Bielefeld.
intro: ELEKTROMECHANIK 2.0 is the second disc of the K&L Studio Serie. It contains {count} programs for the Sound Recorder synthesizers BASILISK 16 and BASILISK SYNTH.

Every program is built from the sound of an electromechanical machine: relays, selector switches, bells, teleprinters, motors and transformers. Each program was tuned against a reference tone of 440 Hz.
intro_de: ELEKTROMECHANIK 2.0 ist die zweite CD der K&L Studio Serie. Sie enthaelt {count} Klangprogramme fuer die Sound-Recorder-Synthesizer BASILISK 16 und BASILISK SYNTH.
Jedes Programm beruht auf dem Klang einer elektromechanischen Maschine: Relais, Waehler, Wecker, Fernschreiber, Motoren und Transformatoren. Alle Programme sind auf den Kammerton 440 Hz gestimmt.
maker_note: Version 2.0 replaces version 1.0 of March 1996. Changes: four new programs, all programs re-tuned, the manual is now bilingual.
A machine that has worked for forty years has a voice. We wanted to keep these voices before the last exchanges are switched to digital.
install: Insert the CD. In the Library tab the CD appears as drive KL_EM_V2.
The programs are in folders by type (GLOCKEN, LEADS, FLAECHEN, ...). Double-click a program to load it.
System requirements: BASILISK 16 (16 Bit) or BASILISK SYNTH (32 Bit).
install_de: CD einlegen. Im Library-Register erscheint die CD als Laufwerk KL_EM_V2.
Die Programme liegen nach Art sortiert in Ordnern (GLOCKEN, LEADS, FLAECHEN, ...). Doppelklick laedt ein Programm.
Systemvoraussetzungen: BASILISK 16 (16 Bit) oder BASILISK SYNTH (32 Bit).
